worldcombat.skill.iciclecrash.summary: Forms a huge icicle above the chosen landing spot and drops it straight down: foes in the landing ring are scoured by shards, and a solid hit may leave them flinched. The spot is fixed at cast and the icicle does not chase, so the target can step aside before it lands; the high drop is heavier but slower, the close drop faster and surer.
worldcombat.skill.iciclecrash.use.2: Drop past a low wall onto a spot behind cover
worldcombat.skill.iciclecrash.use.3: Pin a slow target to its spot
worldcombat.skill.iciclecrash.descriptio: Foes within %2$s blocks of the landing each take one hit for about %1$s damage (a target is struck only once); the target's defence, type and crit are settled on the hit.

The icicle forms up to %1$s blocks above the landing (a ceiling shortens it) and drops straight down at %2$s blocks/tick with a %3$s-block hit radius; the landing is fixed when you cast, so the target can step out of it.
Cast onto a spot or target within %1$s blocks; a ground point, an entity or open air all work.
Each target struck by the icicle has a %1$s chance to flinch for %2$s, interrupting interruptible actions and preventing new moves and ordinary attacks during that time.
worldcombat.skill.iciclecrash.tall.on: High drop on: the icicle forms higher with power x1.15 and a shatter ring x1.2 wide, but adds 6 ticks of wind-up, drops at x0.72 speed and adds 8 ticks of cooldown, giving the target more time to step aside.
worldcombat.skill.iciclecrash.tall.off: High drop off (close drop): power x0.9 and shatter ring x0.85, but it drops at x1.15 speed with a shorter wind-up and cooldown, almost impossible to dodge.
worldcombat.skill.iciclecrash.timing: Cast at a target within %1$s blocks; after %2$s s of wind-up it spends %4$s PP, then recovers for %3$s s and starts a %5$s s cooldown.
worldcombat.skill.iciclecrash.growth.0: At level %1$s the shards rise to %2$s power.
worldcombat.skill.iciclecrash.growth.1: At level %1$s the shards rise to %2$s power, a %3$s block shatter radius, and the flinch chance to %4$s.
worldcombat.skill.iciclecrash.preference: On: the icicle forms higher, hits harder and shatters wider, but the longer, slower fall gives the target time to step aside. Off: a close, fast drop that is lighter and narrower but almost impossible to dodge.
The companion considers Icicle Crash only while a foe is this close; higher opens at range, but the longer fall lets the target slip out of the landing.
Fresh only: skip targets already flinched by another move and save this one for a target that can still be flustered. Always: treat it as an ordinary attack and ignore target status.
